fixture_requirements: At least one centreline alignment with its left/right offset alignments (names parseable into channel and side)
Alignments containing lines and circular curves, ideally spiral segments too, to cover spiral_step tessellation
assertions: data.exported >= 1 and data.skipped explains why entries were skipped
data.bytes > 0 and the out path is an openable DWG
every items[*].length_delta is within tolerance in absolute value (tessellation does not distort)
centrelines land on the layer expanded from the center_layer template, edges on the layer expanded from the edge_layer template
with overwrite=false an existing target must be refused
with centers_only=true no edge lines are exported
